title: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog (Embedded Offline Snapshot)

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: libcurl contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the ASN.1 parser.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Git Remote Code Execution via Submodules
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Git submodule path traversal vulnerability affecting recursive clone operations.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenSSL TLS Session Unconstrained Memory Growth
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Unconstrained memory allocation in TLS sessions leading to DoS.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenSSH regreSSHion Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Signal handler race condition in OpenSSH server allowing unauthenticated RCE.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor patch or mitigate via LoginGraceTime 0.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Windows TCP/IP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: An integer underflow in the Windows TCP/IP stack allows unauthenticated RCE via IPv6 packets.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply August 2024 security updates or disable IPv6.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: HTTP/2 protocol allows a malicious reset stream attack causing denial of service.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply patches provided by web servers and proxy vendors.
